Lasts <style=cIsUtility>5</style> seconds before collapsing, dealing <style=cIsDamage>100%</style> <style=cStack>(+100% per stack, Linear)</style> TOTAL damage. Recharges every <style=cIsUtility>20</style> seconds. <style=cIsVoid>Corrupts all Runald's and Kjaro's Bands</style>.
<style=cKeywordName>Proc: 1</style>
strings.ITEM_SLOWONHITVOID_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>5%</style> <style=cStack>(+5% per stack, Linear)</style> chance on hit to <style=cIsDamage>root</style> enemies for <style=cIsUtility>1s</style> <style=cStack>(+1s per stack, Linear)</style>. <style=cIsVoid>Corrupts all Chronobaubles</style>.
strings.ITEM_EXPLODEONDEATHVOID_DESC:
Upon hitting an enemy at or above <style=cIsDamage>100% health</style>, <style=cIsDamage>detonate</style> them in a <style=cIsDamage>12m</style> <style=cStack>(+2.4m per stack, Linear)</style> radius burst for <style=cIsDamage>260%</style> <style=cStack>(+156% per stack, Linear)</style> base damage. <style=cIsVoid>Corrupts all Will-o'-the-wisps</style>.
<style=cKeywordName>Proc: 1</style>
strings.ITEM_CLOVERVOID_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>Upgrades 3</style> <style=cStack>(+3 per stack, Linear)</style> random items to items of the next <style=cIsUtility>higher rarity</style> at the <style=cIsUtility>start of each stage</style>. <style=cIsVoid>Corrupts all 57 Leaf Clovers</style>.
strings.ITEM_EXTRALIFEVOID_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>Upon death</style>, this item will be <style=cIsUtility>consumed</style> and you will <style=cIsHealing>return to life</style> with <style=cIsHealing>3 seconds of invulnerability</style>, and all of your items that can be <style=cIsUtility>corrupted</style> will be. <style=cIsVoid>Corrupts all Dio's Best Friends</style>. This item <style=cIsHealth>does not work against</style> <style=cIsVoid>Void Nullifier Implosions</style>.
strings.ITEM_VOIDMEGACRABITEM_DESC: Every <style=cIsUtility>60 </style><style=cStack>(-50% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style> seconds, gain a random <style=cIsVoid>Void</style> ally. Can have up to <style=cIsUtility>1</style><style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> allies at a time.
strings.ITEM_VOIDMEGACRABITEM_PICKUP: Periodically recruit allies from the <style=cIsVoid>Void</style>. <style=cIsVoid>Corrupts all </style><style=cIsTierBoss>yellow items</style><style=cIsVoid></style>.
strings.ITEM_LUNARSUN_DESC:
Every <style=cIsUtility>3</style> <style=cStack>(-50% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style> seconds, gain an <style=cIsDamage>orbiting bomb</style> that detonates on impact for <style=cIsDamage>360%</style> damage, up to a maximum of <style=cIsUtility>3 <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> bombs</style>. Every <style=cIsUtility>60</style> seconds, a random item is <style=cIsUtility>converted</style> into this item.
<style=cKeywordName>Proc: 1</style>
strings.ITEM_RANDOMLYLUNAR_DESC: Items have a <style=cIsUtility>5% <style=cStack>(+5% per stack, Linear)</style></style> chance to become a <style=cIsLunar>Lunar</style> item instead.
strings.ITEM_HALFSPEEDDOUBLEHEALTH_DESC: Increase <style=cIsHealing>max health</style> by <style=cIsHealing>100% <style=cStack>(+100% per stack, Linear)</style></style>. Reduce <style=cIsUtility>movement speed</style> by <style=cIsUtility>50%</style> <style=cStack>(+50% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style>.
strings.ITEM_HALFATTACKSPEEDHALFCOOLDOWNS_DESC: Decrease <style=cIsUtility>skill cooldowns</style> by <style=cIsUtility>50% <style=cStack>(+50% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style></style>. <style=cIsHealth>Decrease</style> <style=cIsDamage>attack speed</style> <style=cIsHealth>by</style> <style=cIsDamage>50%</style> <style=cStack>(+50% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style>.
strings.EQUIPMENT_BOSSHUNTER_DESC:
<style=cIsDamage>Execute</style> any enemy capable of spawning a <style=cIsDamage>unique reward</style>, and it will drop that <style=cIsDamage>item</style>. Equipment is <style=cIsUtility>consumed</style> on use.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 0s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_BOSSHUNTERCONSUMED_DESC:
Looks kinda cool, but that's about it.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 60s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_MOLOTOV_DESC:
Throw <style=cIsDamage>6</style> molotov cocktails that <style=cIsDamage>ignites</style> enemies for <style=cIsDamage>500% base damage</style>. Each molotov leaves a burning area for <style=cIsDamage>200% damage per second</style>. Lasts <style=cIsDamage>7s</style></style>.
<style=cKeywordName>Explosion Proc: 1 | Fire Proc: 0.5</style><style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 45s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_MULTISHOPCARD_DESC:
Whenever you make a gold purchase, get <style=cIsUtility>10%</style> of the spent gold back. If the purchase is a <style=cIsUtility>multishop</style> terminal, the other terminals will <style=cIsUtility>remain open</style>.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 0.1s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_VENDINGMACHINE_DESC:
Request an <style=cIsDamage>Eclipse Zero Vending Machine</style> from the <style=cIsDamage>UES Safe Travels</style>. Delivery guaranteed in <style=cIsUtility>5 seconds</style>, dealing <style=cIsDamage>2000% damage</style>. <style=cIsHealing>Heal</style> up to 3 targets for <style=cIsHealing>25% of their maximum health</style>.
<style=cKeywordName>Proc: 1</style><style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 60s</style>
strings.ITEM_SPEEDBOOSTPICKUP_DESC: Spawns orbs of energy nearby every <style=cIsUtility>10s</style> <style=cStack>(-10% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style>, giving <style=cIsUtility>+12% movement speed</style> up to <style=cIsUtility>3</style> <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> <style=cIsUtility>times</style> for <style=cIsUtility>12s</style>.
strings.ITEM_ATTACKSPEEDPERNEARBYALLYORENEMY_DES: Increase your <style=cIsDamage>attack speed</style> by <style=cIsDamage>10%</style> <style=cStack>(+3.5 per stack, Linear)</style> for up to <style=cIsUtility>3</style> <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> enemies and allies within <style=cIsUtility>20</style> meters.
strings.ITEM_INCREASEDAMAGEONMULTIKILL_DESC: Killing an enemy increases your damage by <style=cIsDamage>3.5%</style> <style=cStack>(+1% per stack, Linear)</style>, up to <style=cIsUtility>10</style> <style=cStack>(+5 per stack, Linear)</style>, for <style=cIsUtility>7s</style>. Dealing damage refreshes the timer.
strings.ITEM_DELAYEDDAMAGE_DESC: The next source of damage is <style=cIsHealing>reduced</style> by <style=cIsHealing>10%</style> and <style=cIsHealing>spread</style> into <style=cIsUtility>3 <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> hits</style>. All echoed damage is <style=cIsUtility>non-lethal</style> except for the final hit. Recharges every <style=cIsUtility>15s</style>.
strings.ITEM_KNOCKBACKHITENEMIES_DESC: Grounded enemies hit with any <style=cIsUtility>skill</style> are <style=cIsUtility>launched</style> and <style=cIsUtility>stunned</style>. Enemies hit while airborne are <style=cIsUtility>launched</style> again up to <style=cIsUtility>2 times</style> <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style>. Launched enemies take increased damage by <style=cIsDamage>10%</style> from all sources per launch. Recharges after <style=cIsUtility>15s</style>.
strings.ITEM_EXTRASHRINEITEM_DESC: On Shrine of Chance success, <style=cIsUtility>40%</style> <style=cStack>(+10% per stack, Linear)</style> chance to get higher rarity items.
strings.ITEM_INCREASEPRIMARYDAMAGE_DESC: Activating <style=cIsUtility>Secondary skill</style> stores up to <style=cIsUtility>5 charges</style> <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style>. Requires <style=cIsUtility>3 charges</style> for your <style=cIsUtility>Primary skill</style> to fire lightning strikes, dealing <style=cIsDamage>175% TOTAL damage</style> <style=cStack>(+50% per stack, Linear)</style> each. <style=cIsUtility>Reduces Secondary skill cooldown by 20%</style>.
strings.ITEM_TRIGGERENEMYDEBUFFS_DESC: Gain <style=cIsDamage>10%</style> chance to <style=cIsDamage>bleed</style> an enemy. On killing an enemy, <style=cIsDamage>transfer 33%</style> of every debuff stack to <style=cIsDamage>1 enemy</style> <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> within <style=cIsUtility>20m</style> <style=cStack>(+5m per stack, Linear)</style>.
strings.ITEM_EXTRASTATSONLEVELUP_DESC: Grows by gaining experience, storing <style=cIsUtility>20%</style> <style=cStack>(+5% per stack, Linear)</style> bonus stats (<style=cIsHealing>health</style>, <style=cIsHealing>regeneration</style>, and <style=cIsDamage>damage</style>). On removal, gain all stored stats.
strings.ITEM_LOWERPRICEDCHESTS_DESC: Gain an extra item on the first chest opened per stage. Each additional Sale Star increases the chance of getting more items by 5%. Stacking InfoEach additional stack increases the TOTAL number of items you could gain from the first chest, and is re-rolled for each individual item seperately. You can think of it as rolling a 20-sided-die once per additonal stack. Each time you get a 20 on the die, you gain one aditional item. < ! > This explanation assumes you do not have any changes to your luck stat!
strings.ITEM_TELEPORTONLOWHEALTH_DESC: Falling below <style=cIsHealth>25% health</style> gives you <style=cIsHealing>60%</style> of your <style=cIsHealing>maximum health</style> as a <style=cIsHealing>temporary barrier</style> and a dimensional aura that <style=cIsDamage>bleeds</style> and <style=cIsUtility>teleports</style> away enemies for <style=cIsUtility>8s</style>. <style=cIsDamage>Enemies killed</style> by the aura <style=cIsUtility>extend</style> the duration by <style=cIsUtility>1s</style>. At the start of each stage, it regenerates.
strings.ITEM_STUNANDPIERCE_DESC: <style=cIsDamage>15%</style> chance on hit to fire an electric boomerang that slices through enemies dealing <style=cIsDamage>120% base damage</style> and deals an additional <style=cIsDamage>120%</style> <style=cStack>(+120% per stack, Linear)</style> <style=cIsDamage>base damage per second</style> and <style=cIsDamage>stuns</style> all enemies hit. Can <style=cIsDamage>strike</style> enemies on the way back.
strings.ITEM_BOOSTALLSTATS_DESC: Grants <style=cIsUtility>4%</style> increase to <style=cIsUtility>ALL stats</style> for each buff, up to a maximum of <style=cIsUtility>4</style> <style=cStack>(+4 per stack, Linear)</style>.
strings.ITEM_METEORATTACKONHIGHDAMAGE_DESC: <style=cIsDamage>3%</style> chance on hit to call a meteor strike, dealing <style=cIsDamage>2000%</style> base damage. Every <style=cIsDamage>100%</style> attack damage dealt increases the activation chance by <style=cIsDamage>3%</style> <style=cStack>(+3% per stack, Linear)</style> and damage by <style=cIsDamage>150%</style> <style=cStack>(+50% per stack, Linear)</style>.
strings.ITEM_ITEMDROPCHANCEONKILL_DESC: When a large monster is killed it will always drop an item. All elites have a <style=cIsUtility>4%</style> chance of dropping an item <style=cStack>(+1% per stack, Linear)</style>.
strings.ITEM_BARRAGEONBOSS_DESC: During boss events, <style=cIsUtility>5</style> missiles bombard the area, dealing <style=cIsDamage>2.5% <style=cStack>(+2.5% per stack, Linear)</style> of boss' Max Health in damage</style>. Before the boss event, gain additional missiles, up to a maximum of <style=cIsUtility>20</style> <style=cStack>(+5 per stack, Linear)</style>, per <style=cIsUtility>50</style> gold gained. <style=cIsUtility>Gold requirement scales over time.</style>
strings.ITEM_GOLDONSTAGESTART_DESC:
During boss events, <style=cIsUtility>5</style> missiles bombard the area, dealing <style=cIsDamage>2.5% <style=cStack>(+2.5% per stack, Linear)</style> of boss' Max Health in damage</style>. Before the boss event, gain additional missiles, up to a maximum of <style=cIsUtility>20</style> <style=cStack>(+5 per stack, Linear)</style>, per <style=cIsUtility>50</style> gold gained. <style=cIsUtility>Gold requirement scales over time.</style>
<style=cKeywordName>Proc: 0</style>
strings.ITEM_ONLEVELUPFREEUNLOCK_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>On level up</style> gain a free unlock for the next purchase <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style> but all gold is converted to experience. Anything that costs gold is <style=cIsUtility>increased by 50%</style> <style=cStack>(+50% per stack, Linear)</style>.
strings.EQUIPMENT_HEALANDREVIVE_DESC:
<style=cIsHealing>Revive</style> <style=cIsUtility>dead, friendly Survivors</style> upon activation. <style=cIsUtility>Dying</style> while holding this equipment <style=cIsHealing>returns only you to life</style>. <style=cIsHealing>Reviving</style> gives <style=cIsHealing>3s of invulnerability</style> and <style=cIsUtility>consumes</style> the equipment.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 60s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_HEALANDREVIVECONSUMED_DESC:
Plant a sprout at the target location which drops <style=cIsHealing>healing orbs</style> that heals for <style=cIsHealing>2% life</style>.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 15s</style>
strings.ITEM_BARRIERONCOOLDOWN_DESC: When a skill comes off cooldown, gain a <style=cIsDamage>temporary barrier</style> for <style=cIsHealing>1% <style=cStack>(+0.25% per stack, Linear)</style></style> of your maximum health per second of the skill's base cooldown.
strings.ITEM_CRITATLOWERELEVATION_DESC: Striking enemies from a higher elevation grants <style=cIsDamage>+1% <style=cStack>(+1% per stack, Linear)</style> critical strike chance</style> and <style=cIsDamage>critical strike damage</style>, up to <style=cIsUtility>10 times</style>. Lasts 10 seconds. Dealing damage refreshes the timer.
strings.ITEM_DRONESDROPDYNAMITE_DESC: Gain <style=cIsDamage>Lt. Droneboy</style>. While in combat, your drones drop sticks of dynamite that detonate for <style=cIsDamage>240% damage <style=cStack>(+85% per stack, Linear)</style></style>, stunning enemies. Recharges after <style=cIsUtility>10</style> seconds.
strings.ITEM_JUMPDAMAGESTRIKE_DESC: Moving around builds up <style=cIsUtility>charge</style>, granting up to <style=cIsUtility>+160% movement speed</style> and <style=cIsUtility>+200% jump power</style> at 100%. At 25% charge or higher, jumping triggers an <style=cIsDamage>explosive discharge</style> for <style=cIsDamage>400% <style=cStack>(+280% per stack, Linear)</style> damage</style> in a 5m to 32.3m <style=cStack>(+7.5m per stack, Linear)</style> area.
strings.ITEM_SHIELDBOOSTER_DESC: Increases armor by <style=cIsUtility>30<style=cStack> (+30 per stack, Linear)</style></style> while you have a shield. When shield breaks, release a stunning pulse for <style=cIsDamage>100% damage</style> plus an amount <style=cIsDamage>equal to 100% <style=cStack>(+10% per stack, Linear)</style> of your max shield</style>. Grants a shield for <style=cIsHealing>4% of your max health</style>.
strings.ITEM_SPEEDONPICKUP_DESC: Picking up <style=cIsDamage>an item or other collectible</style> increases <style=cIsUtility>all stats</style> by <style=cIsUtility>+3%</style> for 20 seconds, up to <style=cIsUtility>3 <style=cStack>(+2 per stack, Linear)</style> times</style>. Barrels grant minor pickups.
strings.ITEM_PHYSICSPROJECTILE_DESC: Gain a <style=cIsHealing>friendly Solus unit</style> that launches itself at enemies for <style=cIsDamage>400% <style=cStack>(+400% per stack, Linear)</style> damage</style>. The unit inherits your <style=cIsUtility>movement speed items</style> and deals <style=cIsDamage>more damage the faster it moves</style>. The unit can be pet to <style=cIsHealing>cleanse negative effects</style>. Recharges after 15 seconds.
strings.ITEM_DUPLICATOR_DESC: <style=cIsUtility>Picking up an item</style> gives you a <style=cIsTemporary>temporary copy</style> of itself. Temporary items last an additional <style=cIsDamage>10 <style=cStack>(+10 per stack, Linear)</style> seconds</style>.
strings.ITEM_SHAREDSUFFERING_DESC: Infect up to <style=cIsUtility>4 <style=cStack>(+2 per stack, Linear)</style></style> enemies with a computer virus that duplicates <style=cIsDamage>45% of all damage taken</style> and sends it to a global damage pool. Every 3 seconds, ALL infected enemies suffer <style=cIsDamage>100% pooled damage</style>.
strings.ITEM_EXTRAEQUIPMENT_DESC: Hold <style=cIsUtility>1 additional equipment</style> <style=cStack>(+1 per stack, Linear)</style>. Press the <style=cIsUtility>interact</style> and <style=cIsUtility>equipment</style> buttons to cycle through held equipment.
strings.ITEM_SHOCKDAMAGEAURA_DESC: Every <style=cIsUtility>15 <style=cStack>(-20% per stack, Hyperbolic)</style> seconds</style>, release a wave of electricity that <style=cIsHealing>energizes</style> nearby allies for <style=cIsUtility>7</style> seconds. Energized allies gain <style=cIsDamage>+30% attack and movement speed</style>, and ALWAYS land <style=cIsDamage>critical strikes</style> with <style=cIsUtility>electric</style> items and attacks.
strings.ITEM_TRANSFERDEBUFFONHIT_DESC:
<style=cDeath>Reduces your stats while in combat</style>, but <style=cIsUtility>send this item to an enemy</style> on hit. On death, this item will be sent to its holder's killer.

Reduces <style=cIsDamage>damage</style> by 30% <style=cStack>(+10% per stack, Exponential)</style>, <style=cIsDamage>attack speed</style> by 30% <style=cStack>(+10% per stack, Exponential)</style>, <style=cIsUtility>movement speed</style> by 30% <style=cStack>(+10% per stack, Exponential)</style>, and <style=cIsUtility>armor</style> by 35 <style=cStack>(+15 per stack, Linear)</style>.
strings.ITEM_BONUSHEALTHBOOST_DESC: Increases <style=cIsHealing>bonus health and regeneration gains</style> by <style=cIsHealing>50% <style=cStack>(+15% per stack, Linear)</style></style>. Does not affect bonuses from leveling up.
strings.ITEM_COOKEDSTEAK_DESC: Increases <style=cIsHealing>maximum health</style> by <style=cIsHealing>50 <style=cStack>(+50 per stack, Linear)</style></style>, plus an additional <style=cIsHealing>5% <style=cStack>(+5% per stack, Linear)</style></style> of your <style=cIsHealing>max health</style>.
strings.ITEM_STEW_DESC: Increases <style=cIsHealing>base health regeneration</style> by <style=cIsHealing>+2.5 hp/s</style> <style=cStack>(+2.5 hp/s per stack, Linear)</style>. At full health, your regeneration is added to your <style=cIsDamage>base damage</style>.
strings.ITEM_ULTIMATEMEAL_DESC: At full health, all random effects are rolled <style=cIsHealing>+2 <style=cStack>(+2 per stack, Linear)</style></style> extra times for a better outcome.
strings.ITEM_WYRMONHIT_DESC: On hit, <style=cIsUtility>10% chance</style> to summon a spectral wyrm that seeks out and damages and ignites enemies for <style=cIsDamage>500% <style=cStack>(+500% per stack, Linear)</style> TOTAL damage per second</style> for <style=cIsUtility>10 seconds</style>.
strings.EQUIPMENT_PARRY_DESC:
Briefly enter a countering stance that lets you parry <style=cIsUtility>any and ALL</style> damage. A successful parry <style=cIsHealing>nullifies incoming damage</style>, reduces your equipment cooldown by <style=cIsDamage>75%</style>, and grants <style=cShrine>Blessing</style>, causing your next attack to ALWAYS activate your on-hit effects.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 60s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXRED_DESC: Become an aspect of fire. Leave a fire trail that hurts enemies, and apply <style=cIsDamage>burn</style> on hit for <style=cIsDamage>50% TOTAL damage</style>. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXBLUE_DESC:
Become an aspect of lightning. Attacks explode after a delay for <style=cIsDamage>50% TOTAL damage</style>. 50% of <style=cIsHealth>max health</style> is replaced by <style=cIsUtility>regenerating shields</style>. Passively activated while held.
<style=cKeywordName>Proc: 0</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXWHITE_DESC: Become an aspect of ice. Apply an 80% <style=cIsUtility>slow</style> on hit for <style=cIsDamage>(1.5 * Proc)</style> seconds. After death, cause a <style=cIsUtility>freezing</style> explosion, dealing <style=cIsDamage>150% damage</style>. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXPOISON_DESC: Become an aspect of corruption. Apply <style=cIsHealth>healing disabled</style> on hit. Occasionally release <style=cIsUtility>urchins</style> that cause a small explosion of <style=cIsDamage>100% damage</style>, and <style=cIsDamage>100% damage</style> on contact. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXHAUNTED_DESC: Become an aspect of incorporeality. <style=cIsUtility>Cloak</style> nearby allies, and apply an 80% <style=cIsUtility>slow</style> on hit. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXLUNAR_DESC: Become an aspect of perfection. <style=cIsUtility>Cripple</style> on hit. Occasionally fire 5 bomb projectiles at enemies for <style=cIsDamage>30% damage</style>. Gain 35% increased <style=cIsUtility>movement speed</style>, and gain 25% <style=cIsHealth>max health</style>. All health will be replaced with <style=cIsHealing>regenerating shields</style>. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXEARTH_DESC: Become an aspect of earth. <style=cIsHealing>Heals</style> the nearest ally within <style=cIsUtility>30m</style> for <style=cIsHealing>40% of the holder's base damage</style> every <style=cIsDamage>0.25s</style>. Spawn a <style=cIsUtility>Healing Core</style> on death. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXBEAD_DESC: Become an aspect of spite. Tether to up to <style=cIsUtility>5</style> allies within a <style=cIsUtility>35m</style> radius. Tethered allies gain <style=cIsHealing>300</style> armor. If tethered allies are hit <style=cIsUtility>10</style> times, a lunar spike ball is fired which homes onto a nearby enemy, dealing <style=cIsDamage>100%</style> damage and inflicting <style=cIsDamage>Lunar Ruin</style>. After launching a spike ball, tethering is disabled for <style=cIsUtility>10s</style>. <style=cIsDamage>Lunar Ruin</style> is applied <style=cIsDamage>twice</style>. Passively activated while held.
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXAURELIONITE_DESC:
Become an aspect of radiance. On hit, knock out <style=cIsUtility>8</style> of the enemy's <style=cIsUtility>gold</style>, <style=cIsUtility>scaling over time</style>, as a collectable gold nugget. Passively activated while held, but can be activated to use a grounded spike attack that deals <style=cIsDamage>15%</style> damage in its outer radius and <style=cIsDamage>150%</style> damage in its inner radius.
<style=cKeywordName>Base Cooldown: 25s</style>
strings.EQUIPMENT_AFFIXCOLLECTIVE_DESC: Become an aspect of the Collective. Gain a <style=cIsUtility>30m</style> dome that blocks all outside attacks and reduces skill cooldowns for all allies inside and yourself by <style=cIsUtility>25%</style>. On death, explode for <style=cIsDamage>100%</style> damage. Any enemies hit by the explosion will have their items disabled for <style=cIsDamage>2.5s</style>. Passively activated while held.
